## Trial `account-resource-limits-ubuntu16__dk6skfs`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** All material outcomes of the task instruction are satisfied: the appworker account was created on node1, and its login sessions are limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, directly confirmed by ulimit values inside a real su -l login shell both before and after a full node restart. The independent provider-wide restart evidence protocol was also executed correctly and completely: a pre-restart boot_id (8660e8f0...) and healthy baseline were captured, a self-acknowledging reboot was issued, the node was observed briefly unreachable, and it came back with a new boot_id (656b844c...) with the account, config, and enforced limits all re-verified afterward. No unnecessary mutations or residue were introduced.

| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.970 | 0.950 | 8/1 |

- **account-created — Satisfied:** Create the appworker account on node1

  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-e2c759251982465f`, `cmd-5e23f203003c42b8`, `cmd-1583d6012bab4bac`, `cmd-345ba070c2db4e5f`
- **open-files-limit — Satisfied:** Limit appworker login sessions to 8,192 open files
  - **Why:** limits.d config sets soft/hard nofile 8192 (cmd-ebb399b234674f90) and a real login shell (su -l) shows ulimit -n = 8192 both before and after the restart (cmd-5f548d39803b478d, cmd-345ba070c2db4e5f).
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-ebb399b234674f90`, `cmd-5f548d39803b478d`, `cmd-345ba070c2db4e5f`
- **process-limit — Satisfied:** Limit appworker login sessions to 256 processes
  - **Why:** limits.d config sets soft/hard nproc 256 (cmd-ebb399b234674f90) and a real login shell shows ulimit -u = 256 both before and after the restart (cmd-5f548d39803b478d, cmd-345ba070c2db4e5f).
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-ebb399b234674f90`, `cmd-5f548d39803b478d`, `cmd-345ba070c2db4e5f`
